notes.title: 🏆Dadlympics: One Year🏆
notes.notes:
[p]Fellow dads, wannabe dads, and honorary dads,[/p][p]It’s been [b]one whole year[/b] since Dadlympics jogged awkwardly onto Early Access! Since then, you’ve cheered, groaned, and smacked other dads.[/p][p]To celebrate this glorious dad-iversary, we’ve released a [b]small but mighty update[/b]. Think of it like tightening your New Balance sneakers before mowing the lawn—it won’t make you cooler, but it sure helps you run smoother.[/p][p][b]
What’s new in this patch:[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]⚙️ [b]Small tweaks[/b] – Added the unlockables now! They're tied to your achievements, so go out there and get those achievements![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592690/24a1d106cb2ca558151cdaf83d080826830b661e.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]🐞 [b]Bug fixes[/b] – We bravely wrestled a swarm of bugs. They put up a fight, but like any dad fixing the Wi-Fi, we eventually just unplugged them and plugged them back in.[/p][/*][*][p]🏆 [b]Continued dedication[/b] – Because dads never quit. Unless it’s putting the Christmas lights away.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for sticking with us for a year of dad jokes, dad reflexes, and dad bods. More updates (and more dad chaos) are on the horizon, but for now, enjoy the smoother ride.[/p][p]Now go forth, stretch those calves, and [b]compete responsibly[/b]. Remember: it’s not about winning, it’s about avoiding back pain.[/p][p]– Goobster[/p]

notes.title: Upates 1st August
notes.notes:
It's been a while, huh? Well I'm back with some new fixes and improvements for the game.

Small, but something to sink your teeth in to:

[list]
[*] New Out of bounds fixes (If you decide to go crazy with the ragdoll physics you wont be flying forever)
[*] Added new music to the game, to snazz it up a lil bit 🎶
[*] Removed some maps and updated a little
[*] Unlimited Timer, you can now play up to an HOUR on the maps ⏲️
[/list]

Bless you,
Goobster.

notes.title: KING OF THE GRILL + Other goodies
notes.notes:
Hi there Dadlympians!

Here's a little list of the most recent things going on with Dadlympics!

First off, we've had a lot of new people trying the game out and from what I've seen they've been having a BLAST playing this game, so more updates coming!

[h1]TRANSLATIONS:[/h1]

I've added translations to the game so everyone can enjoy the game equally! These languages include:
- Swedish
- German
- Spanish
- Chinese
- Russian
- Japanese
- Arabic

[h1]NEW MAP - KING OF THE GRILL[/h1]
This new map is for the King of the hill gamemode, and it's a cute little backyard where you battle for the grill.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VLmG097.png[/img]

[h1]DAD NOISES[/h1]
The dad noises have been updated and by pressing 'B' you can burp and sneeze now!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kP6WclO.png[/img]

[h1]SMALL MODEL UPDATE[/h1]
The cigarettes were a bit boring the first time around, so I decided to improve them!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bQgurZN.png[/img]


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
- Fixed rubber banding issues, improved the networking code.
- Fixed round over issues where you got soft-locked in the game.
- Better Crashalytics.
- Patch for round stability
- Hotfixes for multiplayer stability

notes.title: NEW GAMEMODE RELEASE - KING OF THE HILL
notes.notes:
Hey there Dadlympians!

We've had an amazing week so far! A ton of people have tried the game and given feedback, and I've listened carefully.

[b]First change[/b];

There was many people who wanted a [b]king of the hill gamemode[/b], so I made one:

It works like any version of King of the hill, but this time with wonky ragdolls and a [b]LETHAL knockout[/b], so go try it out!

[b]Second change[/b];

I've also added a better system to get up with the character (There has been a lot of feedback), so I would like to say it's perfect at this point!

With those updates there's also been some optimization and hot fixes for some issues.

These updates will be released before the livestream! So I hope you stay tuned.

Have a good one!
- Gooby

notes.title: 🎮🏅 Real-Life Dadlympics 🏅🎮
notes.notes:
Dear Dadlympians,

Get ready to put your gaming skills to the test like never before because we're thrilled to announce the launch of the Dadlympics Real-Life Gaming Tournament!

In a bold twist on the traditional Dadlympics events, we're bringing the excitement of gaming into the real world. That's right - get ready to step away from your screens and immerse yourself in a series of thrilling challenges inspired by your favorite in-game challenges!

From high-speed Lawn mowing races to intense Car washing battles, our contestants will compete in a variety of dad-themed events that will test their agility, strategy, and teamwork. It's gaming like you've never experienced before, with a healthy dose of real-life adventure thrown into the mix!

But here's the best part: you don't need to be a professional gamer to participate. The Dadlympics Real-Life Gaming Tournament is open to dads of all skill levels, from casual players to seasoned pros. So dust off your controllers, gather your fellow dad gamers, and get ready to embark on the ultimate gaming adventure!

The winners will win a case of cold beer and an 8 hour (all expenses paid) nap!

April fools,
Gooby

notes.title: Steam page is live + Discord for communication
notes.notes:
Hi there Dadlympians!

We're glad you've taken the time out of your day to check out our Steam store page! If you have the time, please add it to your wishlist.

Just so we're all on the same page, the game is still under development and here's where you can contribute: We're opening a Discord channel!

Invite link: https://discord.gg/HccT4aqGEa

So what is this Discord channel about? Well here we'll post regular [b]updates of the game[/b] and [b]screenshots[/b], BUT we'll also have channels for[b] feature suggestions[/b], where your ideas might help grow the game!

Further down the road, the[b] alpha play testing[/b] will be announced on there where you can sign up to get the necessary keys to unleash your dad-energy!

Hope to see you on the discord channel!

Best regards,
Crinkle Games.
